quotations.old_english: Ðæt we siððan forþ ða séllan þing symle móten geþeón
quotations.english: that henceforth we may ever do those better things

source_text: ge-þeón; p. -þeóde To do, commit, perform; perficere, patrare :-- Ðæt we siððan forþ ða séllan þing symle móten geþeón that henceforth we may ever do those better things, Exon 13 a; Th. 23, 31; Cri. 377. v. þeón.
